model_sql:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.ProductID,
        p.ProductName,
        p.Category,
        SUM(l.Quantity) AS UnitsSold
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'Products') }} p
    JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'Sales_OrderLines') }} l
        ON l.ProductID = p.ProductID
    GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.ProductName, p.Category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ProductID,
        ProductName,
        Category,
        UnitsSold,
        lower(rtrim(Category)) AS category_key,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC, ProductID) AS rank_all,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(rtrim(Category)) ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC, ProductID) AS rank_in_category
    FROM sales
)
SELECT
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    Category,
    UnitsSold,
    category_key,
    rank_all,
    rank_in_category
FROM ranked
param_filter: (@Category IS NULL AND rank_all <= @TopN) OR (@Category IS NOT NULL AND category_key = lower(rtrim(@Category)) AND rank_in_category <= @TopN)

explanation: This procedure returns the top N products by total units sold, based on order lines, and can optionally be limited to one product category. Products are ranked by units sold (ties broken by ProductID), and only the first N rows are returned. When a category is supplied, the ranking is done within that category only.
